name: Monaco
system_note: The prince holds substantial executive power.
snapshot: The world's most densely populated country, a tax haven for the very rich ruled by the Grimaldi family since 1297.
culture: Monaco's Grand Prix, run through its streets since 1929, and the Monte Carlo Casino define its glamour. The Grimaldi family has ruled almost continuously since 1297, and Grace Kelly's marriage to Prince Rainier in 1956 made it famous worldwide. Monégasque, a Ligurian dialect, is taught in schools though French is official.
society: Citizens are a small minority among residents, who pay no income tax. Land reclamation has expanded the territory. The economy rests on finance, property, tourism and the super-rich. In 2024 Monaco was placed on an international grey list for money laundering risks.
baseline: Prince Albert II has reigned since 2005. Christophe Mirmand, a French official, became Minister of State, the head of government, in 2025.

leaders.gov: Minister of State Christophe Mirmand, since 2025
